code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH). There is also monocytosis and basophilia, with low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages. Protein is low, but liver and renal function are preserved. The findings suggest acute inflammation or infection (possibly viral), with hypoxemia and mild cytopenias; clinical correlation and further evaluation for respiratory compromise and infection are recommended.
